主要内容: Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc. elected new directors at its annual meeting on July 17, 2018. The directors include Thomas B. Akin, Frank P. Filipps, Stewart B. Koenigsberg, George A. Mangiaracina, and Richard H. Pickup. George A. Mangiaracina was appointed Chairman of the Board. The Board also appointed directors to various committees, including the Audit Committee, Compensation Committee, and Governance & Nomination Committee. The stockholders approved an amendment to the 2010 Omnibus Incentive Plan, increasing the number of shares available by 300,000 shares. The amendment aims to enhance the Company’s flexibility in granting stock options and other awards. The proposal required a majority vote of the votes cast in person or by proxy. The amendment was approved by a vote of stockholders as follows: Votes For 8,329,599, Votes Against 1,510,959, Abstentions 27,393, Broker Non-Votes 7,329,168.
